# LM3 supplier anchors and local equivalents

<!-- Generated by tools/automation/buildable-trainset.sh; do not hand-edit. -->

Real supplier product families provide a purchasable/RFQ baseline and a reproducible interface target. They are anchors, not mandatory brands: a local equivalent is accepted only after the same controlled equivalence dossier passes.

**Release boundary:** A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.

Checked against manufacturer sources on **2026-08-30**.

## How to use this register

1. Use the named family to obtain an RFQ, sample, interface drawing and evidence pack; do not infer an order code from the family page.
2. Freeze the chosen order code/configuration and its controlled supplier documents in the city revision.
3. A local supplier may propose an equivalent. Compare it against every mandatory rule and product acceptance item, then repeat affected subassembly and vehicle tests.
4. Preserve the original anchor, accepted-equivalent record and hashes so later regeneration changes cost and geometry without silently changing safety assumptions.

Mandatory equivalence dossier:

- same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
- same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
- same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
- documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
- first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
- signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes

## Known fit gaps

- `OSR-ANC-DOOR-IFE`: Exact aperture, stroke, voltage, software and certification configuration remains to be quoted.
- `OSR-ANC-GLASS-AGC`: Curvature, heater power, optical zones, laminate stack and frame/bond geometry remain project-specific.
- `OSR-ANC-FINISH-3M`: Exact film, colour/ink, overlaminate, edge treatment, fire evidence, hot-climate durability and warranty territory remain to be selected and tested.
- `OSR-ANC-COOLROOF-PURDUE`: No commercial rail-qualified product, vehicle durability pack, fire evidence or released LM3 application procedure is established by the research paper.
- `OSR-ANC-HVAC-LONGERTEK`: Public material does not freeze the LM3 24 kW duty, rail evidence or roof envelope.
- `OSR-ANC-PV-SUNMAN`: Select an exact module and rail-compatible clamp/bond stack after the roof curvature and electrical string are frozen.
- `OSR-ANC-FLOOR-FORBO`: Structural board selection and the final covering/adhesive combination remain to be frozen.
- `OSR-ANC-SEAT-FAINSA`: Exact seat model, upholstery, spacing, handrail geometry and calculated attachment loads remain open.
- `OSR-ANC-PASSENGER-LUMINATOR`: Exact display, camera, amplifier, intercom, recorder and software licences remain to be selected.
- `OSR-ANC-LIGHT-TEKNOWARE`: Exact lamp models, optics, voltage variants and emergency battery arrangement remain open.
- `OSR-ANC-FASTENER-BOLLHOFF`: Exact grip range, head, thread, material and setting force must be selected from each released joint drawing.
- `OSR-ANC-COMPOSITE-GURIT`: No public product family alone establishes the complete LM3 rail fire/structural laminate; formulation and process qualification remain open.
- `OSR-ANC-MOTOR-ABB-AMXM`: The current HM47-class planning envelope is not an ABB order code; ABB must confirm a 250 kW continuous / 350 kW short-peak, 800 V-compatible configuration and mass envelope.
- `OSR-ANC-GEAR-VOITH-SE`: Ratio, centre distance, torque, coupling, reaction-link and lubrication configuration remain to be quoted.
- `OSR-ANC-TRACTION-ABB`: The ABB platform is a rail-qualified architecture anchor, not proof that one published configuration meets the LM3 800 V LFP, 225 kWh/car, side-pin charging, packaging or price targets.
- `OSR-ANC-FIRE-FOGTEC`: Battery chemistry, enclosure, detection thresholds, nozzle layout, reservoir and control integration remain project-specific.
- `OSR-ANC-WHEELSET-GHH`: Wheel profile, diameter, axle journal, disc seats, material grades and load spectrum remain to be frozen.
- `OSR-ANC-AXLEBOX-SKF`: Bearing size, journal fit, housing, grounding, speed/temperature sensor and cable interfaces remain to be frozen.
- `OSR-ANC-SUSPENSION-CONTI`: Continental anchors spring systems; centre pivot, yaw-link and damper suppliers still require project RFQ and a common body-to-bogie interface control drawing.
- `OSR-ANC-BRAKE-KNORR`: The LM3 brake concept needs supplier confirmation of actuation energy, caliper variant, disc/pad pair, parking brake and whether the suspension-only compressor can support the selected brake architecture.
- `OSR-ANC-COUPLER-DELLNER430`: The published 600/500 kN family is an anchor; height, articulation, fold, electrical head, crash stroke and OSR pocket loads remain to be frozen.
- `OSR-ANC-JOINT-SCHAEFFLER`: No catalogue bearing is selected until the articulation load spectrum, pin diameter, angular motion and safety factors are released.
- `OSR-ANC-GANGWAY-HUBNER`: The vehicle-specific bellows, bridge, turntable, clamp and open-end drawbar geometry remains to be engineered with the supplier.
- `OSR-ANC-TRAINLINE-IGUS-HARTING`: The final carrier series, connector inserts, cable compounds, hose lengths and articulation sweep remain to be frozen.
- `OSR-ANC-CONTROL-MOXA`: Moxa anchors computing/network hardware only; the independent safety controller, navigation sensors, HMI and safety relays need exact part selection and safety allocation.
- `OSR-ANC-RECORDER-HASLER`: Exact recorder family, protected memory, interfaces and national event-data requirements remain open.
- `OSR-ANC-OBS-OUSTER`: The commercial sensor is an envelope/data anchor, not railway obstacle-detection certification or a complete T-OBS function.
